# Absorb LMS

> Absorb LMS is the industry's #1 G2-ranked AI-powered learning management system for enterprise training, featuring advanced AI capabilities, comprehensive analytics, and seamless integrations.

Absorb LMS provides a complete learning technology platform with AI-driven course creation, smart administration, and customer success support. The platform serves enterprises across North America, EMEA, and APAC regions with award-winning solutions for employee training, compliance, and upskilling.
